method: Remaining necessary gates only. Original IAB/selector failures retained. Natural rotation captures are native Canvas.toDataURL synchronously after final render (no DOM, no image edits), with same-frame physical nodes. No quaternion/clock override; mobile quality button intentionally hidden, desktop quality evidence is in initial batch.

checks.name: desktop native rotation actual final Canvas frame
mobile natural side-view final Canvas retains actual physical path
mobile native pause holds path without extra solve
mobile first card clears all beam geometry
mobile reverse restores latest valid path
mobile beam stays outside captures and before cards
mobile wall exits glass and white light
mobile actual departure disposes own resources
mobile actual history return restores one working beam
reduced motion retains a stable readable white path

limitations: IAB control failed twice during initialization; design thread reported the same failure and authorized the existing Playwright fallback.
DPR1 / SwiftShader / emulated mobile are not real-device performance evidence.
Natural poses at separate actual times; no fixed 60/85 degree claim.
